# googleworkspace_role_assignments (Data Source)

Lists every admin role assignment in the account: who holds which admin role, and whether it covers the whole account or a single organizational unit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_role_assignments" "all" {}
data "googleworkspace_users" "all" {}

# Super admins by email.
locals {
  emails_by_id = { for u in data.googleworkspace_users.all.users : u.id => u.primary_email }
  super_admins = [
    for a in data.googleworkspace_role_assignments.all.role_assignments :
    lookup(local.emails_by_id, a.assigned_to, a.assigned_to) if a.is_super_admin
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `role_assignments` (Attributes List) All role assignments, ordered by role name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_assignments))

<a id="nestedatt--role_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_to` (String) ID of the user, group, or service account holding the role. Join with `googleworkspace_users` on `id` to get an email.
- `assignee_type` (String) `USER` or `GROUP`.
- `id` (String) Role assignment ID.
- `is_super_admin` (Boolean) Whether the role is the super admin role.
- `org_unit_id` (String) For `ORG_UNIT` scope, the unit as `id:...`; otherwise null.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the assigned role.
- `role_name` (String) Name of the assigned role, e.g. `_SEED_ADMIN_ROLE` for super admin.
- `scope_type` (String) `CUSTOMER` (whole account) or `ORG_UNIT`.
